name: Jets to Brazil
label: Jade Tree
lede: Blake Schwarzenbach walked away from Jawbreaker and a Geffen deal, took a name off a poster in Breakfast at Tiffany's, and made the best-selling record Jade Tree ever put out.

eras.title: Two major-label refugees in New York
eras.text: After Jawbreaker ended, Blake Schwarzenbach moved to New York and started over on a four-track. He and his new bassist were both still tied to major labels, and getting free of them came before anything else.

years.h: Blake Schwarzenbach starts over in New York with a drum machine
years.p: After [[Jawbreaker|ec88cdc3-0517-4951-b5ef-7323e7316db0]]'s breakup, Schwarzenbach moves to New York City and makes four-track recordings over a drum machine with bassist [[Jeremy Chatelain|29c980d7-b22b-4b16-ac37-d3dff47c00a5]] of Handsome.

years.h: Geffen passes on Jets to Brazil, freeing Schwarzenbach and Chatelain
years.p: Schwarzenbach was still signed to Geffen and Chatelain to Epic. Geffen declined to sign Jets to Brazil, and both men were released from their contracts.

years.h: Chris Daly joins, and names the band after a Breakfast at Tiffany's poster
years.p: [[Texas Is the Reason|b93c736f-a82f-4cae-9e57-a60b12d7055f]] drummer [[Chris Daly|6ece778e-233f-40b6-93c2-807129660b79]] joins. He suggests Jets to Brazil after seeing it on a poster in the 1961 film Breakfast at Tiffany's.

years.h: Jets to Brazil's live debut, set up by Jade Tree
years.p: Jade Tree signed Jets to Brazil on the strength of its demo and organized the first shows. The band plays live for the first time in April 1998.

years.h: Jets to Brazil tours Europe with The Promise Ring
years.p: Before the album is even out, Jets to Brazil tours Europe with Jade Tree labelmates [[The Promise Ring|63a6fae8-d39e-4de6-bfd4-9bcbf489a565]].

q: The worst album I have ever heard.
years.h: Orange Rhyming Dictionary, Jade Tree's best seller
years.p: Cut in twelve days in August 1998 at Easley McCain in Memphis with [[J. Robbins|3babd931-a940-43a8-b629-d7aed5b821d9]], it became the best-selling release in Jade Tree's history. Pitchfork gave it 8.7.
years.xp:
Not everybody was sold. The Sun-Sentinel's Rachel Phillips hated it, and AllMusic's Mike DaRonco said the band lived up to the hype.

The closing acoustic song, Sweet Avenue, later had a strange second life on peer-to-peer networks, where it was often mislabeled as a [[Damien Rice|2119beb8-6ac5-4f21-82a4-b831c90c0024]] song.

eras.title: A fourth member, a keyboard
eras.text: A second guitarist let Schwarzenbach move to keyboards, and the band's second album was bigger and more layered. It became their best-charting record and took them to Japan.

years.h: Brian Maryansky of The Van Pelt joins on guitar
years.p: With [[Brian Maryansky|c84367ba-2cbc-4884-9562-89e9409565aa]], formerly of [[The Van Pelt|4ce909db-0da6-4eed-bfe6-6c1f71e265b0]], on guitar, Blake Schwarzenbach can focus on vocals and keyboards.

years.h: Four Cornered Night reaches No. 19 on Heatseekers
years.p: Recorded March to May 2000 at Inner Ear with [[J. Robbins|3babd931-a940-43a8-b629-d7aed5b821d9]], it reached No. 19 on Billboard's Heatseekers chart and sold over 48,000 copies in the US.
play: You're Having the Time of My Life

years.h: On the road with Cave In and Shiner
years.p: Jets to Brazil tours the US with [[Cave In|f3c95ad4-215b-4519-8660-84c9f467da05]] and [[Shiner|85e4c862-bafe-48a2-a7af-b87cc3d8a7f3]] behind Four Cornered Night.
After a US tour in April and May with The Love Scene and New End Original, Jets to Brazil plays Japan in June 2001.

eras.title: Perfecting loneliness, then quitting
eras.text: The third album was long and divisive. The tour behind it was cancelled on opening night, the drummer left, and less than a year after the record came out Jets to Brazil was gone, for reasons nobody spelled out.

years.h: Perfecting Loneliness, with a song for a cat named Chinatown
years.p: Recorded in April and May 2002 with [[J. Robbins|3babd931-a940-43a8-b629-d7aed5b821d9]] and nearly 68 minutes long. Cat Heaven is for Blake Schwarzenbach's cat Chinatown, who got sick and died.
years.xp: Punk Planet called it amazing. Pitchfork's Eric Carr dismissed it as decent arrangements recycled. The cat shared its name with a song on Orange Rhyming Dictionary.

years.h: Jets to Brazil's headlining tour is cancelled on opening day
years.p: The US tour for Perfecting Loneliness is called off on the day of the first show, because of an illness in the band.

years.h: Chris Daly leaves; Matt Torrey drums the last tour
years.p: Drummer [[Chris Daly|6ece778e-233f-40b6-93c2-807129660b79]] departs. Matt Torrey plays when Jets to Brazil goes back on the road from May to July 2003.

years.h: Jets to Brazil breaks up after the summer tour
years.p: Less than a year after Perfecting Loneliness, Jets to Brazil disbands. No reason was ever given publicly.

eras.title: Everybody back to their old bands
eras.text: Schwarzenbach became an English teacher and cycled through new bands before Jawbreaker finally came back. Daly returned to Texas Is the Reason. A Jets to Brazil reunion stayed a maybe.

years.h: Chris Daly back with Texas Is the Reason at Irving Plaza
years.p: Daly reunites with [[Texas Is the Reason|b93c736f-a82f-4cae-9e57-a60b12d7055f]] for shows at Irving Plaza in New York, and tours with them again in 2012 and 2013.

years.h: Blake Schwarzenbach forms The Thorns of Life, then Forgetters
years.p: Now teaching English at Hunter College, Schwarzenbach starts The Thorns of Life, which ends in August 2009. [[Forgetters|0d3f4272-e36c-4dbe-b62e-421a1a6c19ed]], with [[Against Me!|a66ebddc-ff04-46b8-820a-15c63e80dba1]] drummer Kevin Mahon, follows.
Twenty-one years after it ended, [[Jawbreaker|ec88cdc3-0517-4951-b5ef-7323e7316db0]] announces a reunion for Chicago's Riot Fest.

years.h: Blake Schwarzenbach on a Jets to Brazil reunion: maybe one day
years.p: At a Q&A for the Jawbreaker documentary Don't Break Down, Schwarzenbach says a Jets to Brazil reunion may happen someday, but Jawbreaker comes first.
